After cancellation, numerator N=1-V_r(x)V_r(y); for r>=3, N(c,0)=1 prevents x-c and y-c factors, while substituting y=c/x gives nonzero highest Laurent coefficient -c*x^(r-2) when c!=0, excluding xy-c. Over C every numerator of a single F(x)G(y)J(xy) product has only these factor types. The denominator is positive for x,y in (0,1), and monotonic V_r ensures maximal product at a=b=1; its unique crossing gives tau_r>1/2 and tau_3=(sqrt(5)-1)/2. The Calkin–Wilf telescoping sum is absolutely convergent by geometric decay, not merely finite numerical evidence.
